# checklist.gg

> An AI-powered checklist and workflow automation platform offering 1000+ templates, printable planners, and ChatGPT integration for task management and productivity.

checklist.gg combines intelligent checklist generation, template libraries, and browser extensions to help users streamline workflows across marketing, sales, SEO, and personal productivity. The platform emphasizes user empowerment with a privacy-first approach.

- AI-powered checklists

- Task management

- Process improvement

- CRM workflows
